rows.en: This should be fun!
I'm going all out today!
You dare make enemies of us, the Practice Squad!?
Heh, amateurs.
Take this!
uncertain: Shared with other pilots (Mikelo, Hugo, generic); kept generic.

rows.en: Don't underestimate the Practice Squad!
You are destined to fall here!
Here I go!
uncertain: Shared with many pilots (Kouji, Boss, Tetsuya, etc.); kept generic "Here I go!".

rows.en: I can hold my own even flying solo!
The glory is mine!
Watch me, Captain, sir!
Bad luck for you! This is the end!
You're mine!!
Heh, got you...!!
I've found you, Dragonar!!
This is a once-in-a-lifetime chance!
If I can just destroy that radome...!
You're filthy! Have you no shame!
This is the end! Fall!!
I'll make you regret laying a hand on me!
You won't escape me!!
Now it's my turn to attack!
I'll bury what's left of you! Brace yourself!
This is what you get for acting without thinking!
Stay out of our way!
We have not lost yet!
Ngh, next time we'll win!
Ugh! How disgraceful of me!!
Why!? We're supposed to be the superior ones!
Did I just take a direct hit!?
D-Damn you...! You will pay for this, I swear it!
Nuah! I refuse to end in a place like this!
Damn! Even my sensors aren't working!?
What a monster! At this rate...!!
No...! We are the chosen elite!
Even if it costs my life, I'll take down Dragonar!!
Damn gun platform! I can't handle this!
uncertain: Source calls the enemy a gun battery/turret; likely the artillery-type D-2. Rendered "gun platform".

rows.en: Impossible! Beaten by a mere D-3!?
Blast it, quit darting around!
You should have just behaved yourself!
I can't fall with my goal only half achieved!
Damn youuuuu!!
Hmph! That's what they call beginner's luck!
That was chance! It wasn't my mistake!
Hmph! Aren't you a brave one!
This is not nearly enough to break me!
D-1, eh? Just what I wanted!
You don't care about tactics at all...!
Tch, insolent for an electronic warfare unit!
Hmph, what's that supposed to be?
You're still not good enough...!
Fighting like this is simply dishonorable...!
Nothing's scarier than an amateur...
Useless! This unit has special armor!
You'd do well to learn some manners.
We're in a different class from you people!
Someone like this has a D-Weapon... What a waste.
You're only a support unit, don't get cocky!
Coming at me with the D-3? Have you lost your touch?
You won't hit me!
Amateur! You can't handle that machine!
In real combat, we are superior!
Why can't you see the gap in our power!?
What's wrong, coward!
You still want to keep going!?
As pilots, we find this deeply shameful.
uncertain: Meaning inferred: as pilots they find this (the enemy fighting style or their own showing) shameful.

rows.en: So much for your famed close combat skills!
They're all talk...
This much finesse is only natural.
Guess that's the difference in combat experience.
Go ahead, waste your ammo!
Heh, you lack fighting spirit!
uncertain: Glossary hit Drive (spirit command) not used; here the word means general fighting spirit, not the command.

rows.en: My ammo's running low...
Blast it! At a time like this!!
Tch, I can't open up any distance!!
Honestly, what do they take this holy war for!
I'll finish it!!
Please, leave this to me, Welner Fritz!
Captain, sir, I'll support you!
Formation!
Good! Just like in training!
Leave this to me!
Fall back while you can!
I won't let you!
I'll be your shield! Retreat!
Ngh!? You... you're using us as bait!?
uncertain: Who is using the Practice Squad as bait is unstated (likely an ally such as the Gon Jem Squad); addressed as "you", no gender.

rows.en: Don't let up the attack!
Our chance to show them our power! All at once!
Rest assured, sir!
Leave it to me, sir!
Do you know your way around a sword?
Careless! Approaching without a plan!
Amateur! You're wide open!
Shut up and become my trophy!
Become rust on my noble saber!
This is the end!
Heh, you fool!
I'll put you out of your misery now!
Good position! Take this!!
I'll make sure you never run that mouth again!!
I'll show you the pride of the Royal Guard!
We are the Practice Squad! Give up!
Your luck ends here!!
Tough luck! You had to run into us!
Toy soldiers, you say? Then how about this!!
D-1! Now I settle my long-held grudge, here and now!!
Even a D-Weapon is helpless once I'm in its blind spot!
Greeting us with a lone D-3? You underestimate us!
We've been waiting for this chance all along!
Do you know you're facing the Practice Squad!?
You won't leave here alive!
My turn! Take this!!
You don't even know the basics of combat!
Just sink quietly!
Nnngh! I won't forget this humiliation!
Uaaah! Captain, sir!!
Ngh! We'll pull back for today!
Hngh! You think you've won this!?
Don't think luck alone will keep you alive!
Waaah!! Th-This one... it's the real deal!?
The conviction the Captain gave me won't break easily!!
When did you get this strong!?
Am I in the D-2's range!? I have to pull out!
I-I'm completely locked on!?
Ngh, clever trick!!
Do you think you can compete with us!?
Hmph! I don't sense a shred of class in you!
You think resolve that weak can bring us down!?
Tch, so the machine's performance covers for its pilot!
That big lug... It should've stuck to rear support!
So you saw it coming. What a pain...!
How dare you scratch my beloved machine!
Not knowing one's place is a frightening thing...
Surrender while you still can!
We are the elite of the Imperial Guard Armored Corps!
Such a fine D-Weapon, wasted on a pilot like this!
Is that all!? The D-Weapons are nothing to fear!
We have sensors more sensitive than a maiden's skin!
uncertain: Interpretation: "only fool around in form" read as a jab at the D-unit looks; meaning uncertain.

rows.en: Keep the clowning to your machine's looks!
uncertain: Glossary lists Otome as a character name; here it is the common noun "maiden", so not used as a name.

rows.en: I'll admit your machine performs well!
Is that all the D-1, your main unit, can do!?
You should've kept quiet and stuck to support...!
That machine seems unfit for real combat!
You people can't put up a real fight!
Ignorance is a frightening thing...
Fool, you don't even know the basics of combat...
Missiles are useless!
Good, the jammer is working!
Kindly stop this nonsense!
Blast it, I'm out of ammo!
I can't even counter... How humiliating...!
This glory belongs to us, and us alone!
Heh heh, a follow-up strike!!
Captain, sir! I've come to support you!
This is the Practice Squad's show!
Not so fast!!
I'll stop you!!
You won't lay a finger on the Captain!
C-Captain Min!!
I don't like it, but it can't be helped!
Combination attack! Here I go!!
I'll slice you to ribbons!
My saber alone is more than enough for you!
Even worthless trash... still has to be cut down!
uncertain: Literal: even a worthless thing must be cut; rendered "worthless trash".

rows.en: Hiheheheh... Die!
Heh heh heh! So long!
My skill and my mech are on another level! Here, here, heeere!
Burn! Burn every last one of you to ash!!
Let's see what you've got!
You pathetic maggots! You're no match for me!!
Hyahaha!! Here it comes, here it comes, here it comes!
Once I blow off those wings, you're all mine...!
I'll take you all out at once, Dragonar!
You're gonna die right here!!
You're a pain in the ass! Get blown away!!
That's what pisses me off about you!
Hurry up and croak!!
All three Dragonars are going to hell!!
Ngaaaaah!!
You'll pay for this!
Ngh, guess it's time to pull out!?
Dammit, you'll pay for this! You Dragonar bastards!!
You...! You want me to butcher you that bad!?
Gah! I ain't ending this with you laughing at me!
Nnngh! I can't drag the mighty Gon Jem Squad through the mud!
Tch! If I go back like this, the Colonel will tear into me!
Knock it off already! I don't swing that way!
uncertain: Ganan telling a persistent pursuer he is not interested "that way"; joke kept as "I don't swing that way".

rows.en: What a screwup, and from me of all people...!
Tch! Are these D-Weapons monsters or what!?
Keh! Don't get cute with me!
So you can pull it off once in a while!
Hah! Don't get cocky!!
You ain't even worth tensing my gut for!
Keeeh! I'll crush you to a pulp!!
A nail's got more bite than you do!
Not bad!! You Dragonar bastards!!
What the hell are you!?
Now it's getting fun!
Using a cheap trick like that... Heh heh heh...!
Mine's custom-made! Like that's gonna work!!
Geez, you're hopeless!
You trying to rile me up? Hyahyahyahyahya!!
Dragonar ain't nothing special!
You can't hit me!
Hiheheheh... What a letdown.
Heh! Easy as anything!
Geez, you're all talk...
Kukuku... This is fun!
Struggle, struggle! It just makes it more fun for me!
They're really sweating now!!
I can't keep playing with you forever!
You're in my way!
Tch, I'm out of ammo... It's your lucky day!
Huh!? It's nothing, come on, come on, come on!
Keh! Lost your nerve or something?
Ngh! I can't reach!?
Tch, they got into my blind spot!
I'll finish 'em off!
Pardon me, coming from behind!
Colonel, I'm taking 'em out!
Hey! Don't forget I'm here!
Like hell I'll let you!
You sure are a lucky one!
I won't let 'em hit the Colonel!
Whoa whoa, you're gonna get hit, y'know?
I'm makin' my move!!
Sorry, but this is where you die!! Get 'em!!
A raid!? Fine by me!!
I know, I know!
I'll crush you!
Go to hell!
I'll send you to the next world!
All right, commence attack!
We can do this, commence attack!
I'll finish this in one go!
I'm going for a direct hit! Go!
I'll end this!
I won't drag this out! First strike wins!
For the proud Giganos Empire!
We of the Giganos army won't lose!
You fool, defying Giganos!
I'll show you a Metal Armor's mobility!
I've got you in my sights!
You're in range!
I never thought I'd fight the Blue Hawk of Giganos!
Just a man who defected to the enemy!
Blue Hawk, my foot! I'll make my name shooting you down!
Even if it's a D-Weapon!
We're both Metal Armors! The gap can't be that big!
You annoying D-Weapon, go down!
It's only a prototype!!
You elite little rich boys!
You've been getting on my nerves for ages!
You Blue Hawk's lapdogs!
I'm not beaten yet!
I'll pay you back for that!
Switching to interception!
Intercept!
I'll meet you head-on! Here I go!
My turn to attack! Take this!
Don't think I'll just sit here and take it!
I'm counterattacking right now!
I won't go down without a fight!
L-Long live United Empire Giganooos!
uncertain: Banzai rendered as "Long live"; glossary name United Empire Giganos kept verbatim.

rows.en: Wh-Whoaaaah!
G-Glory to Giganooos!!
It's no good! Uoooooh!
A direct hit on the generator!? Waaaaah!
I-It's gonna blow! Waaaaah!
D-Damn youuuuu!!
Ngh... I won't give up!
Guooh! A direct hit!?
It pierced my armor!? Impossible!
It still moves! I'll fight... to the very end!
A-At this rate... it'll explode!
I-I'm going to be shot down!?
Kuuh! What do I do!?
I can't take any more damage!
I-I'm losing!? At this rate I'll lose!
I'm cornered!? No!
It's tearing through my armor like paper!?
On the pride of the Giganos army, I can't lose!
The soul of Giganos... will never die!!
Uoah! Can't I win with this Metal Armor!?
I-I knew it, I'm no match!!
Blue Hawk of Giganos! You traitooor!
Uuugh... I could never win...!!
S-So terrifying... that's... a D-Weapon...!
A Metal Armor has this much firepower!? Impossible!
D-Damn you! You D-Weapon!!
Guoh! I'm just getting started!
You're better than I thought!
That's more damage than I expected!
Uoooh! A clean hit!?
Gh! Damage check! ...This is bad.
Not good! My armor!
I can still move... but this is bad, really bad!
Damn! Like I'll go down like this!
The fight's just beginning!
Nothing stopping me from fighting on!
Combat functions are normal!
Gh! I won't go down like this!
Ugh, am I being pushed back!?
At this rate I'll be cornered!
I can still move... but I'm being pushed back!
A-Any more and... I'm in trouble!!
I can't track its movements! Is this the Blue Hawk!?
O-Of course, they know all our tactics...!
uncertain: Read as the defected Blue Hawk knowing Giganos tactics; used "they" since the opponent varies.

rows.en: The Blue Hawk... isn't even fighting seriously yet!?
That's a D-Weapon for you! I never thought it'd be this good!
I see, you move well!
We're both Metal Armors! Why is there such a gap!?
Ha! Just a scratch!
Armor damaged! Nothing serious!
As long as it's not a direct hit!
Whoa, is that all?
That's not much damage!
You think a weapon like that can beat me!?
Hahahahaha! What was that!
Are you even trying?
uncertain: Shared with Saiga; works for both.

rows.en: It only hit me, that's all!
uncertain: Shared with Federation Soldier; works for both.

rows.en: Don't underestimate Metal Armor plating!
Damage is minor!
Ugh! I can't fully block it!?
Tch! The fight's only just begun!
Blue Hawk of Giganos, my foot!
How far the Blue Hawk has fallen!
That's all a traitor's power amounts to!
That's a D-Weapon? Hmph, it's all looks!
We were afraid of a Metal Armor like that...
Some D-Weapon! Is this all it is!?
Here it comes! Evade!!
You won't hit me!
My training paid off!
Is that all you've got!
Ugh! Can my shield stop it!?
Shield, hold out for me!
Barrier device activated!
Optical weapons won't work on me!
Beams won't work on me!
I can block missiles!
Missiles won't work on me!
That's useless!
uncertain: Shared with Royal Guard Captain Mors; works for both.

rows.en: An attack that slow won't work!
That's easy!
I can shoot this much down!
I'll knock it down!
No way... my ammo!?
I dragged this out too long! My ammo!
No... were they waiting for this!?
I forgot to check my ammo... What a mess!
They can attack from this range!?
Got me! From my blind spot!?
I can't do anything at this range!
They got into my blind spot!
Damn! I can't get the range right!
From that far away!?
It's no use! There's nothing I can do!
Providing support fire!
We can do this!
I'll cover you!
uncertain: Shared with Dan Krueger; works for both.

rows.en: Captain Plato! I'll cover you!
Get back!
I'll cover you! Fall back!
Leave this to me!
I won't let them hit my comrade!
Don't overextend! Fall back!
Leave this to me and retreat!
Watch out! Captain Plato!
We strike all at once!
Got 'em! Concentrate fire!
Wait for the timing... Now!
We'll make the first move!
All right, if I attack now...!
We'll finish it here!
I'll land a direct hit! Go!
Damn you! You D-Weapon!!
We're both Metal Armors! Why is there such a gap!?
If I can just get in close!
Now that I'm this close!
At this range!
I'll knock you down up close!
